Hand-lens view at about 10x of pond water: very thin bright green hair-like threads tangled in clear water, too thin to show inner detail, a few bubbles. No lens frame, no text.
Educational cutaway: a mushroom growing from a decaying log; the log cut open to show white branching threads (mycelium) spreading through the wood and joining the stem base. No text, no labels.
